items.title: Kyron now speaks your language everywhere.
items.detail: The buttons, menus, empty screens and error messages that were still in English are now translated in all 68 languages, and the language screen no longer claims parts of the app stay in English.

items.title: Back takes you Home, not out.
items.detail: From Explore, Communities or Messages, back goes to Home; on Home, it asks for a second press before Kyron closes, so a stray back never leaves the app.

items.title: See who gave a post its gifts.
items.detail: Tap the gift pill: everyone who sent one, the biggest giver first and named as such, with what they sent.

items.title: Every part of a notification opens its own page.
items.detail: A face or a name opens that person, the picture opens the post, and a reply's words open the reply.

items.title: What's new, after each update, once, so you can see what changed.
A quick check-in on your third and tenth day: one tap on a face, and a line if you have something to say.
Reminders, now and then.
items.detail: After a day and a half away, an evening note about what's new, only if something is; and on Monday, a note that your gift coins are back, if you spent some.

items.title: Full-width buttons are the login button's size.
items.detail: They were 8 points taller and heavier than it, across settings, sheets and moderation screens; every one is now exactly the same 40-point pill.

items.title: A profile's tabs sit on the page in the dark theme, not on a grey band across it, and the ring round the profile picture is the page's black instead of grey.
Gifts have a place of their own.
items.detail: What a post has been given — its best gifts and how many — is a small pill on the bottom-right corner of the post, on words, photos, voice notes and links alike, and never over any of them.

items.title: Mentions are gold.
items.detail: An @name in a post is a deep gold on white and a bright yellow on black, so a post is no longer all one blue: tags and links are places to go, a mention is someone.

items.title: Select all goes once everything is selected, instead of staying in the menu doing nothing.
Recent screens speak your language.
items.detail: Editing a post, sorting comments, the gift sheet, gift notifications, saved comments, the text menu, the AR lens camera and a post's gift analytics were English in every language.

items.title: The comment sort menu has an edge in the light theme.
items.detail: It was white on white with only a faint shadow; it now has a fine line round it.

items.title: Bug fixes and performance improvements.
Edit a post.
items.detail: For 15 minutes after posting, your post's menu has Edit post: change the words, and the post says "Edited".

items.title: Sort comments.
items.detail: Top or Recent, from the end of the comments heading.

items.title: Videos play like TikTok.
items.detail: A tap pauses once it is clear it is not a double tap; a double tap likes without stopping the clip, and more taps are more hearts.

items.title: The bar on a post's page changes at its own pace — the same calm change however fast the scroll — and turns round smoothly if you scroll back halfway.
A shared comment opens the comment.
items.detail: Comment links used the address communities use, so tapping one opened an empty community page.

items.title: Scrolling the feed while a post is deleted no longer errors.
items.detail: Counting what you have seen could trip over a post removed at the same moment; that post is now simply skipped.
